## Stay Safe & Connected — At Home & On-the-Go

Get peace of mind for everyone in the circle-of-care. Voice-activated; No Wi-Fi needed.

[![Aloe Care Health Hub](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/604013ab91c9a949fca70f6b/6202e27f1c06a044bdc4b539_features-aloe-care-hub.jpg)](https://www.aloecare.com/products/essentials)

### The Hub

Use the voice-activated Smart Hub or the Care Button to connect directly to our 24/7 Emergency Response Center.

[![Aloe Care Health Apps](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/604013ab91c9a949fca70f6b/65329c6dd7a71fe8325aa716_Aloe%20Care%20Health%20Dashboard%20Checkin%20AppStore%20Badges.png)](https://store.aloecare.com/app?utm_source=getaloecarecom)

### The App

Caregivers stay connected through the app (iPhone and Android) for real-time updates and ability to make App-to-Hub calls.

[![Aloe Care Health Mobile Companion 2](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/604013ab91c9a949fca70f6b/6532a84383a25da36b0057d7_Mobile%20Companion%202.2.png)](https://www.aloecare.com/products/mobile-companion-2)

### Mobile Companion 2

Get help inside/outside the home with our Mobile Companion; includes automatic fall detection (not guaranteed to detect all falls) so you always feel safe.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/604013ab91c9a949fca70f6b/639b9ca4d6a46d43dc347735_label-new.svg)

Our professional response team is always on-hand, ready to get the right level of support—whether it's your family or emergency services.
